From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + proposed windows for a short demo (HealthWorks POC)

Hi Aamir / Sofia —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap: you're evaluating an inference platform to run a small POC (channeling EHR anonymized summaries) with a focus on latency and audit logs. Next best step from our side is a ~45 minute technical demo showing the inference runtime, KV caching, and how we'd integrate with HealthWorks' S3 flow.

Proposed 45-minute windows (all times PT):
- Monday 1 Mar, 09:30–10:15 PT (12:30–13:15 ET)
- Tuesday 2 Mar, 11:00–11:45 PT (14:00–14:45 ET)
- Wednesday 3 Mar, 08:00–08:45 PT (11:00–11:45 ET)

Can you confirm which slot works, and please confirm who from your side will attend (engineer(s) + security/procurement if possible). I’ve cc'd Monica (solutions engineering) so she can join the demo and prepare a short checklist.

We also have a short one‑pager I can attach that maps demo content to evaluation criteria — want me to include that in the invite?

Next steps: confirm slot + attendee list and I’ll send a calendar invite with the video link and one‑pager.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555‑0142

- Aamir Khan (platform eng)

Appreciate it — see you then.
Sofia
